other_conditions: Applicant must be an individual artist
Applicant must have given a substantial contribution in his/her respective field of art
Applicant must have contributed in Goa for a minimum of 10 years out of his/her entire career as a practising artist
benefits_summary: The award includes a shawl, shrifal, certificate of appreciation and a cash prize of ₹25,000 per recipient (up to 30 awardees per year).
